statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The patient reports intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
The patient's dizziness and palpitations are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings
Diagnosis codes G45.9 and I49.9 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
Cardiac event monitoring is clinically indicated for this patient
